dining.name: Popeyes Restaurant
dining.brand: Gulf Brand For Fast Food CO
dining.description: The Gulf Brand Fast-Food Company (GBFF), exclusive master franchisee of the US fried chicken giant Popeyes, has opened its fourth restaurant in Riyadh. After opening its first Popeyes restaurant on Anas Bin Malik Street in Riyadh which offers a bright and vibrant family-friendly atmosphere and a convenient Drive thru, GBFF opened two cloud kitchens restaurants, and its latest restaurant on Imam Saud Road in Massif, Riyadh. Guests can look forward to enjoying Popeyes world-famous products, such as the brand’s signature Chicken Sandwich, Chicken on the bone, and Tenders, perfectly marinated for 12 hours in a unique blend of Louisiana seasonings. Founded in New Orleans in the United States in 1972, Popeyes has over 45 years of history and culinary tradition with over 3,600 locations in more than 25 countries. Popeyes is one the world’s largest chicken quick-service restaurants serving chicken dishes in bold and spicy flavors. Popeyes introduces for the first time in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia its hero Sandwich “The SANDWICH” which comes to you along with the whole menu items 100% local and fresh sourced chicken from Tanmiah Farms. GBFF is planning to open hundreds of new Popeyes restaurants in the Kingdom over the coming years. The Popeyes restaurant with mouth-watering crunchy and juicy fried chicken bursting with Louisiana flavor can quickly establish itself as a lifestyle-led hospitality leader. The new restaurant is designed with the precise needs of the cosmopolitan Saudi market in mind to bring a unique, world-class addition to the Kingdom’s ever-evolving dining scene. GBFF aims to make Popeyes available to guests in every place in the Kingdom through digital platforms, including the mobile app & website. Gulf Brand Fast-Food Company’s strategy to develop the Popeyes presence in the Kingdom will allow it to create hundreds of career opportunities and share the joy of Popeyes with the people of Saudi Arabia.

movies.title: HAMNET
movies.synopsis: "1580 England. Impoverished Latin tutor William Shakespeare meets free-spirited Agnes, and the pair, captivated by one another, strike up a torrid affair that leads to marriage and three children. Yet as Will pursues a budding theater career in far-away London, Agnes anchors the domestic sphere alone. When tragedy strikes, the couple’s once-unshakable bond is tested, but their shared experience sets the stage for the creation of Shakespeare’s timeless masterpiece, Hamlet. From Focus Features and Academy Award® winning filmmaker Chloé Zhao (Nomadland, The Rider) comes a sensitively observed, magnificently crafted tale about the complexities of love and the healing power of art and creativity.Stars Jessie BuckleyPaul MescalZac Wishart"

movies.title: THE SPONGEBOB MOVIE: SEARCH FOR SQUAREPANTS
movies.synopsis: SpongeBob and his Bikini Bottom friends set sail in their biggest, all-new, can’t miss cinematic event ever…The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants. Desperate to be a big guy, SpongeBob sets out to prove his bravery to Mr. Krabs by following The Flying Dutchman – a mysterious swashbuckling ghost pirate – on a seafaring comedy-adventure that takes him to the deepest depths of the deep sea, where no Sponge has gone before.

movies.title: EL SELEM W EL THOBAN (ARABIC)
movies.synopsis: In Snakes and Ladders, love and ambition intertwine as Ahmed (Amr Youssef), a creative architect, and Malak (Asmaa Galal), a driven entrepreneur, struggle to reconcile who they’ve become with who they were together. When distance and new relationships—like Malak’s rekindled connection with Amir (Dhafer L’Abidine)—test their bond, both are forced to confront lost versions of themselves and the choices that shaped their paths.
